svg.title: Path medians range from 25 to 102 seconds
svg.desc: 168 selected source posts, ordered by path median preview duration. External video model, n=10: median 24.757 seconds, middle 50% 19.331 to 52.819 seconds; 3D / real-time graphics, n=19: median 34.176 seconds, middle 50% 23.018 to 64.171 seconds; Existing-source edit, n=32: median 40.544 seconds, middle 50% 26.813 to 56.848 seconds; Code-drawn 2D, n=52: median 46.379 seconds, middle 50% 30.000 to 105.643 seconds; App / game capture, n=14: median 50.297 seconds, middle 50% 32.650 to 116.135 seconds; Mixed / unestablished, n=14: median 51.787 seconds, middle 50% 27.528 to 152.912 seconds; Educational explainer, n=27: median 102.281 seconds, middle 50% 60.053 to 256.538 seconds. These manually selected cases are not a random sample.
